inputs.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/madworld
CF=/opt/madworld/ops/docker-compose.production.yml
DF=/opt/madworld/ops/docker-compose.deploy.yml
ENVF=/opt/madworld/.env
echo DRIFT_REPAIR_V2_START cmd-20260908-153500-prod-abuse-schema-drift-repair-v2
echo '--APPLY_034_DDL--'
docker compose -f "$CF" -f "$DF" --env-file "$ENVF" run --rm migrator python -c "from app.infrastructure.db import create_engine_from_env; e=create_engine_from_env(); c=e.connect(); c.exec_driver_sql(\"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS abuse_control_hits (id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, control_key TEXT NOT NULL, hit_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_abuse_control_hits_key_time ON abuse_control_hits(control_key, hit_at); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS abuse_control_replays (replay_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, seen_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_abuse_control_replays_expiry ON abuse_control_replays(expires_at); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS abuse_control_scores (actor TEXT PRIMARY KEY, score INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (score >= 0), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now());\"); c.commit(); print(c.exec_driver_sql(\"SELECT to_regclass('public.abuse_control_hits'), to_regclass('public.abuse_control_replays'), to_regclass('public.abuse_control_scores')\").one()); c.close()"
echo '--RESTART_API--'
docker compose -f "$CF" -f "$DF" --env-file "$ENVF" up -d --no-build api
sleep 5
echo '--HEALTH--'
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'health=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8090/health
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w 'ready=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:8090/health/ready
curl -k -sS -o /dev/null -w 'public=%{http_code}\n' https://api.autosklo.org.ua/health
echo '--STATUS--'
docker compose -f "$CF" -f "$DF" --env-file "$ENVF" ps -a
free -m | head -2
echo DRIFT_REPAIR_V2_DONE
